facts.fact: An extraordinary Council of Ministers meeting approved by majority vote the Regulatory Framework for the Public Data Protection Law, drafted by the Ministry of Communications and Technology; no commencement is stated and the meeting date is not given (date is the article's published date).

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers approved the implementing regulation for the Public Data Protection Law, reported on 8 January 2026.
